annotations.title: 印紙税はいくら？（領収書・不動産の譲渡・請負の契約書）

description: Look up Japanese stamp duty (印紙税) for a paper receipt for sales proceeds (領収書, 第17号の1 売上代金の受取書), a real-estate transfer contract (不動産売買契約書, 第1号の1) or a contract for work (請負契約書, 第2号), including the reduced rates for real-estate transfer and construction contracts made from 2014-04-01 to 2027-03-31. It looks up the amount in the NTA table for the document type the caller specifies (e.g. receipts under ¥50,000 are non-taxable); which document type a document is, is chosen by the caller (the user). `amount` is the tax-inclusive total written on the document (pass null when no amount is written; omitting it is an error); when consumption tax is stated separately (or both tax-inclusive and tax-exclusive prices are written), set consumption_tax_separately_stated with consumption_tax_amount, or pass amount_excluding_consumption_tax (with consumption_tax_separately_stated: true) instead of amount — consumption tax is then excluded, as the NTA circular says. Per NTA No.7108, a contract based on a construction contract that also lists design or other work is treated as a whole as a construction contract. Based on National Tax Agency tables (laws as of 2026-04-01). It does not decide which document number a document falls under, and does not cover other document types or electronic documents.

amount.description: 書類の金額（円・消費税額等を含めた税込の合計）。消費税を区分して書いている時も税込の合計を入れる。金額を書いていないなら null を明示する（渡さないと誤り）。amount_excluding_consumption_tax とどちらか片方だけ

amount_excluding_consumption_tax.description: 税抜の額（円）を amount の代わりに渡す時。消費税額等を区分して書いているか、税込と税抜の両方を書いている書類だけで、consumption_tax_separately_stated: true も要る。この額で表を引き、consumption_tax_amount は使わない

business_related.description: 領収書だけ。営業に関しない受取書なら false（非課税）。既定 true

consumption_tax_amount.description: 区分して書いた消費税額等（円）

consumption_tax_separately_stated.description: 消費税額等を具体的に書いている時、または税込と税抜の両方を書いている時は true（消費税額＝税込−税抜）。既定 false

created_on.description: 書類を作った日（YYYY-MM-DD）。無ければ今日（日本の日付）

document_type.description: 呼ぶ側（利用者）が選ぶ書類の種類。receipt＝売上代金の領収書（第17号の1）、real_estate_transfer_contract＝不動産の譲渡の契約書（第1号の1）、construction_contract＝建設工事の請負（第2号。建設工事の契約に基づく書類なら、設計など建設工事以外の事を一緒に書いていても全体がこれ）、other_work_contract＝建設工事以外の請負（第2号）

name: jp_stamp_duty

checked_on.description: Cyclix Agents が出所を最後に確かめた日

doc_url.description: 人が読む説明のページ（式・出所・例）。利用者に次に読んでもらう先

law_as_of.description: 出所が書く法令の基準日（例：2026-04-01＝令和8年4月1日現在法令等）

notes.description: この答えに効いた決まり・前提（日本語）

taxable_amount.description: 表を引くのに使った金額
